# ProRestoration Services

> 24/7 restoration services in Bakersfield, CA.

ProRestoration Services (ProRestoration Services Inc.) is a professional restoration contractor serving Bakersfield, CA and surrounding areas. We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: (661) 393-9306 · Email: .
